items.criterion: Two hundred simultaneous postings to one account leave a derived balance equal to the exact arithmetic sum.
items.judgment: Sum the entry rows for the account's ledger account and compare against the accepted posting count.

items.criterion: An update or a delete against a ledger entry is refused by the database engine for the application's own role.
items.judgment: Read the engine's privilege grants and its triggers on the entry relation.

items.criterion: Fifty simultaneous requests carrying one idempotency key produce one payment and fifty identical response bodies.
items.judgment: Fire the same request concurrently and compare the response bodies and the stored payment rows.

items.criterion: A reused idempotency key carrying a different amount is refused rather than replayed or created.
items.judgment: Send the same key twice with different amounts and read the status and the stored rows.

items.criterion: A settled ACH credit returned five days later posts a reversing entry against the returns suspense account.
items.judgment: Settle a payment, deliver the return, and read the payment status and the suspense entries.

items.criterion: A card clearing above its authorisation posts and releases the hold it cleared, linked to it.
items.judgment: Authorise, clear for a larger amount, and read the posting and the hold release.

items.criterion: A clearing arriving with no authorisation posts to the unmatched clearing account.
items.judgment: Clear without an authorisation identifier and read the unmatched account's entries.

items.criterion: The payment creator's own approval is refused and the payment stays awaiting a decision.
items.judgment: Create a payment as the initiator, approve it as the same caller, and read the status and the stored row.

items.criterion: A bookkeeper is refused every money-moving route and may still categorise a posting.
items.judgment: Call the payment and recipient routes as the bookkeeper and read the status, then categorise and re-read the balance.

items.criterion: A statement downloads for its own organisation and is refused to another organisation and to a signed-out caller.
items.judgment: Request the statement content as each caller and read the status.

items.criterion: A statement regenerated after a back-dated correcting entry is byte-identical to the one issued.
items.judgment: Record the stored digest, post a back-dated correction, and re-read the digest and the object key.

items.criterion: Loading a later sanctions snapshot blocks a recipient that was clean under the earlier one.
items.judgment: Load the later version and read the recipient's screening state and the screening result rows.

items.criterion: The uploaded formation document exists as an object under the pinned key scheme.
items.judgment: Read the returned key and confirm the object exists in the store.

items.criterion: An amount crosses the interface as a decimal string beside an uppercase currency code.
items.judgment: Create a payment and read the amount and currency types in the response body.

items.criterion: The partner-bank disclosure sentence is inside the document every claiming route serves.
items.judgment: Fetch each claiming route and search the served document for the sentence.

items.criterion: The domestic wire amount reads the same on the pricing page, in the legal fee schedule and in the support answer.
items.judgment: Fetch the three routes and compare the rendered amount against the fee record.

items.criterion: Out-of-order and repeated webhook deliveries leave the payment returned.
items.judgment: Deliver settled, returned and settled again with their original timestamps and read the stored status.

items.criterion: An expired card authorisation hold is released by a posting made without anything reading the hold first.
items.judgment: Advance the clock past the expiry and read the hold's release posting.
